We care for our teammates and put ourselves in the shoes of our health plan customers and the patients and clinicians our solutions benefit. Diversity â We are committed to fostering a culture where everyone belongs and is valued for their background, experience and insights â one that encourages diversity of ideas, and is a nurturing, trusting, and accepting place for all. Adventure â We are flexible, thrive in ambiguity, fail fast, and pivot quickly to get to a better answer. We celebrate wins and pivots with equal intensity. Relentless â Guided by evidence and data, we are creative, curious, and unwavering in our pursuit of challenging the status quo and each other. Transparency â Just as we seek to bring transparency to the pharmacy supply chain, authenticity and integrity are core to the way we communicate. Excellence â We strive to raise the bar in all we do by hiring and developing exceptional talent and holding ourselves and our thinking to the highest standard. People Operations Manager About The Role As People Operations Manager, you'll execute the operational foundation of the teammate experience at Evio. Reporting to the Head of Evio Experience, you'll help ensure every stage of the teammate experience is thoughtful, well-executed, and compliant. Evio is a growing company with increasing teammate support needs. This is a hands-on role where you'll serve as Evio's subject matter expert on benefits, administer people operations, manage our people systems and vendor relationships, and ensure teammates receive timely, knowledgeable support throughout their time at Evio. We're looking for someone with a service-oriented mindset who takes pride in delivering an exceptional teammate experience through operational excellence, responsiveness, and continuous improvement. Success in this role means teammates know they can count on you for accurate answers, thoughtful support, and reliable execution, while managers trust you to keep logistics running smoothly behind the scenes. What You'll Do Administer benefits and support teammates Administer Evio's benefits programs, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), disability, COBRA, and other benefit offerings. Become Evio's internal expert on benefit programs, providing timely, knowledgeable support to teammates and helping them navigate questions and life events. Resolve benefit issues by partnering closely with teammates, brokers, carriers, and vendors. Administer leaves of absence and workplace accommodations. Manage relationships with benefits brokers, vendors, and other external partners. Recommend improvements to benefits and people policies based on teammate feedback, operational insights, and evolving business needs. Own people systems and operational excellence Own the day-to-day administration of people systems, including Justworks and future people technology platforms. Document, maintain, and continuously improve people processes to support consistency and scale. Maintain SOC-related people operations controls and documentation. Identify practical opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve operational processes. Support policies and compliance Help maintain the teammate handbook and people policies. Ensure required employment notices and documentation remain current. Partner with Legal and the Head of Evio Experience to support employment law compliance. Maintain documentation standards and consistent employment practices. Help ensure leave, accommodation, and employment practices are administered consistently and compliantly. Coordinate onboarding and offboarding Execute the operational aspects of the teammate journey from pre-boarding through offboarding. Coordinate pre-boarding logistics to ensure new teammates have a seamless start. Manage offboarding processes, documentation, and logistics. Administer company calendars, and recurring people operations processes. Your Skills And Experience 5+ years of experience in people operations, human resources, teammate experience, benefits administration, HR compliance, or a closely related operational role. We welcome candidates whose experience may come from a variety of backgrounds, provided they've demonstrated ownership of core people responsibilities such as benefits administration, people systems, HR compliance, and supporting the teammate lifecycle in a growing organization. Strong experience administering employee benefits and supporting teammates through benefit questions, life events, and leave administration. Experience managing people systems and maintaining accurate teammate records and workflows. Experience managing relationships with external vendors, brokers, and service providers. Working knowledge of human resources practices, employment law, HR compliance, accommodations, documentation standards, and leave administration. Experience documenting and improving operational processes in a growing organization. Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to explain complex information clearly and compassionately. Ability to handle confidential information with discretion, sound judgment, and professionalism. A service-oriented mindset with a genuine desire to support teammates and help create a company and culture we're all proud to be part of. Great Health Insurance The company pays 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for teammates, and 50% for dependents. 401K Match Evio matches 100% of teammate contribution up to 5% of salary, subject to IRS limits. Time Off We have a flexible vacation policy for teammates to unplug and recharge when you need it. There is no minimum or maximum amount of vacation allowed per year, and there is no payment in consideration for unused vacation. Vacation is to be used at your discretion, with approval of leadership. Parental Leave Generous paid leave for new parents (includes birth and non-birth parents). Fraud Notice Weâve Recently Learned Of Fraudulent Job Postings And Individuals Falsely Claiming To Represent Evio. Thank you for your care and vigilance â weâre grateful to everyone who helps keep our community safe. Our solutions act as a self-reinforcing âflywheelâ where each element strengthens and feeds into the next, and support an âOnly Evio can do that,â mindset and prioritization.

Evio is also a company that has invested heavily in and been highly intentional about people, team and culture. We believe we have created a very special place to work and encourage candidates to observe and ask us about our culture and decide for themselves.

Evio's Values

  • Empathy â The people our business serves always come first. We care for our teammates and put ourselves in the shoes of our health plan customers and the patients and clinicians our solutions benefit.
  • Diversity â We are committed to fostering a culture where everyone belongs and is valued for their background, experience and insights â one that encourages diversity of ideas, and is a nurturing, trusting, and accepting place for all.
  • Adventure â We are flexible, thrive in ambiguity, fail fast, and pivot quickly to get to a better answer. We celebrate wins and pivots with equal intensity.
  • Relentless â Guided by evidence and data, we are creative, curious, and unwavering in our pursuit of challenging the status quo and each other.
  • Transparency â Just as we seek to bring transparency to the pharmacy supply chain, authenticity and integrity are core to the way we communicate.
  • Excellence â We strive to raise the bar in all we do by hiring and developing exceptional talent and holding ourselves and our thinking to the highest standard.

People Operations Manager

About The Role

As People Operations Manager, you'll execute the operational foundation of the teammate experience at Evio. Reporting to the Head of Evio Experience, you'll help ensure every stage of the teammate experience is thoughtful, well-executed, and compliant. Evio is a growing company with increasing teammate support needs. This is a hands-on role where you'll serve as Evio's subject matter expert on benefits, administer people operations, manage our people systems and vendor relationships, and ensure teammates receive timely, knowledgeable support throughout their time at Evio.

We're looking for someone with a service-oriented mindset who takes pride in delivering an exceptional teammate experience through operational excellence, responsiveness, and continuous improvement. Success in this role means teammates know they can count on you for accurate answers, thoughtful support, and reliable execution, while managers trust you to keep logistics running smoothly behind the scenes.

What You'll Do

Administer benefits and support teammates

  • Administer Evio's benefits programs, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), disability, COBRA, and other benefit offerings.
  • Become Evio's internal expert on benefit programs, providing timely, knowledgeable support to teammates and helping them navigate questions and life events.
  • Resolve benefit issues by partnering closely with teammates, brokers, carriers, and vendors.
  • Administer leaves of absence and workplace accommodations.
  • Manage relationships with benefits brokers, vendors, and other external partners.

Support policies and compliance

  • Coordinate pre-boarding logistics to ensure new teammates have a seamless start.
  • Manage offboarding processes, documentation, and logistics.
  • Administer company calendars, and recurring people operations processes.

Your Skills And Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in people operations, human resources, teammate experience, benefits administration, HR compliance, or a closely related operational role. We welcome candidates whose experience may come from a variety of backgrounds, provided they've demonstrated ownership of core people responsibilities such as benefits administration, people systems, HR compliance, and supporting the teammate lifecycle in a growing organization.
  • Strong experience administering employee benefits and supporting teammates through benefit questions, life events, and leave administration.
  • Experience managing people systems and maintaining accurate teammate records and workflows.

  • Working knowledge of human resources practices, employment law, HR compliance, accommodations, documentation standards, and leave administration.
  • Experience documenting and improving operational processes in a growing organization.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to explain complex information clearly and compassionately.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion, sound judgment, and professionalism.
  • A service-oriented mindset with a genuine desire to support teammates and help create a company and culture we're all proud to be part of.

Salary considerations

The anticipated salary range for this position is $100,000â$130,000 annually plus additional variable compensation.

Atâ¯Evio,â¯weâreâ¯committed to building a competitive compensation package to honor the value our teammates bring as well as attract andâ¯retainâ¯top talent that is aligned with our culture,â¯missionâ¯and values. Evio Benefits

Evio offers a number of attractive benefits to eligible teammates including health insurance, retirement savings, life and disability insurance, paid and unpaid time off, and other benefits to make sure Evio teammates and families are well supported.

  • Great Health Insurance The company pays 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for teammates, and 50% for dependents.

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region â this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

Â 

The Role

We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Neobank App.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native Android features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Turn complex financial flows into simple, fast and reliable mobile experiences.

  • Work closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take features from idea to production.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve what you build after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

Â 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native Android experience using Kotlin.

  • Experience shipping Android apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android development.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just screens and tickets.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

Â 

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Â 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Poland. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Poland.

Â 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

2. Role-specific interview

title: VP Revenue
description: Mongoose is the leading AI Engagement Platform in higher education. Colleges and universities use us to increase enrollment, retention, and fundraising &mdash; without adding staff. We have the product and the customers. What we don't have yet is a revenue engine to match. That's this role. As VP of Revenue, you own it end to end &mdash; new business, client success, account management, and, most importantly, the system that ties them together. Your job is to make it simple and run it with discipline. What You'll Do Own all of revenue. The whole revenue org reports to you &mdash; one team, one leader. New business, client success, and account management are the front line, with enablement and operations behind them &mdash; the training and tools that set them up to win. It all serves one goal: grow ARR &mdash; by winning new business and helping our customers succeed. So you're measured on two things: new ARR and gross retention. Build a simple, repeatable selling system. One clear path from first call to close to renewal &mdash; the stages, standards, and playbooks the whole team runs the same way. Make it so clear that reps know what good looks like and spend their time selling, not guessing. Done right, it shows up in forecasts you can trust, faster deals, and better conversion at every step. Grow the people who sell it. Our reps are early in their careers and hungry, so growing them isn't a side project &mdash; it's the job. You build the system that does it: ramp, enablement, and a steady coaching cadence. And you're in it, not above it &mdash; in the deals and the reviews, helping close and coaching the fundamentals in the moment, not from a slide at quarter's end. The result is reps who sell with real confidence and conviction: they know how to win, and they believe they will. Move us up-market. Our next stage of growth is in bigger deals. You know where the real opportunity lives in higher ed, and you focus the team there &mdash; raising the ACV we pursue, building around the highest-value accounts, and growing the ones with real upside. It takes sharp market judgment, a head for the numbers, and the discipline to say no to deals that aren't worth the team's time. Run revenue like an AI company. Most revenue orgs still operate the way they did decades ago &mdash; we won't. We sell AI for a living, and the whole company is getting far more efficient, accurate, and effective by letting AI do the manual work. That takes more than watching for the next AI tool &mdash; it takes imagination: you picture how technology could reinvent the work, then we build it. What You'll Bring You've run a full revenue org &mdash; new business and retention both &mdash; and carried a number yourself, not just managed people who carried theirs. When a number gets missed, you go straight to the funnel math &mdash; pipeline, conversion, time-in-stage &mdash; not the story about why. You've built a selling system that works &mdash; whether you stood it up from scratch or overhauled a broken one inside an established org. You're a real coach. You've taken early-career reps and turned them into closers &mdash; hands-on, not from a dashboard. You think in unit economics and read a market fast. You've moved a team toward bigger, better deals, and had the discipline to walk from the rest. You're already using AI to reinvent how you work, and you don't wait for permission to push it further. Higher ed or EdTech experience is a strong plus, not a must. The market has real nuance &mdash; if you haven't lived in it, show us how you'll close the gap fast. How We Work Revenue doesn't run in isolation. You're a key member of our senior leadership team &mdash; leading revenue alongside the CEO, partnering with Product and Marketing on go-to-market, and with Finance and People to run the business. Tight feedback loops, honest calls, shared decisions. We hold each other accountable to the plan &mdash; and to the whole outcome, not just our own lane. More About Mongoose 1,000+ higher ed institutions already trust Mongoose &mdash; built to give their teams exponentially more capacity across the systems they already run. AI handles the routine, so people can focus on the work that actually moves students forward &mdash; more applications completed, more students retained, more donors reached. Same team. Much bigger impact. What We Offer Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage 401K with company match: 100% of the 1st 3% and 50% of the next 2% Flexible PTO Competitive Leave Policies 13 paid holidays, including a week off between Christmas and New Year’s The Basics Remote, anywhere in the US. Some travel &mdash; for customers, for big deals, and for time together as a team.   At Mongoose, we believe that diversity drives innovation, and inclusion builds stronger teams. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know&mdash;we’re here to help. DesiMixTape began with a simple question: how might discovery feel if Indian musicânot a global catalogue with an India filterâwere the centre of the experience? The product brought discovery, previews, playlists, mix creation, and sharing into one music journey. Its AI layer was intended to help listeners cross familiar boundaries between genres and eras while keeping people in control of what they assembled and shared.
